biocs.name: Unusual Archive Password Usage
biocs.description: Detection of zip extraction with a non-standard password length or pattern
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'unzip' and action_process_command_line contains '-P'
| filter action_process_command_line matches '123456789'
